units.source_text: 薰中纳言入内参见明石皇后。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, entered the palace and paid his respects to the Akashi Empress.

units.source_text: 皇后对他说道：“匂皇子又出门去了，这种行径真是太不成样啊！

en.t: The Empress said to him, "Prince Niou has gone out again; such behavior is truly improper.

units.source_text: 皇上闻知了，定将怪我不加管束，教我怎么办呢？”

en.t: If the Emperor hears of it, he will surely blame me for not keeping him in check. What am I to do?"

units.source_text: 皇后所生许多皇子，皆已长大成人，但她自己越发显得青春貌美了。

en.t: The many princes born to the Empress had all grown to adulthood, yet she herself looked ever more youthful and beautiful.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想道：“大公主一定长得和母后一样美貌。

en.t: Kaoru thought, "The eldest princess must surely be as beautiful as her mother.

units.source_text: 但愿有个机会，使我得像现在对皇后一般接近，至少听听她的娇音也好。”

en.t: If only I might have a chance to be as near to her as I am now to the Empress, or at least hear her lovely voice."

units.source_text: 继而又想：“世间好色之徒，对不应该恋爱的人寄予相思，正是由于具有此种关系，即并不疏远，却又不能接近，因而发生的。

en.t: Then he thought, "When amorous people in this world fall in love with those they should not love, it arises precisely from such a relationship: not distant, yet impossible to approach.

units.source_text: 像我这样性情乖僻的人，可谓世无其类了。

en.t: A man as perverse in nature as I am may well be without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 然而一旦钟情了那个人，相思之苦便不堪言。”

en.t: And yet, once I give my heart to that person, the pain of longing is beyond words."

units.source_text: 皇后身边的侍女，容姿和品性没有一个不良的。

en.t: Among the ladies serving near the Empress, not one was lacking in beauty or character.

units.source_text: 个个模样端正，相貌姣好。

en.t: Each was graceful in bearing and lovely in appearance.

units.source_text: 其中也有特别艳丽、惹人注目者。

en.t: Among them were some who were especially radiant and drew the eye.

units.source_text: 然而薰中纳言抱定主意，决不动心，对她们态度非常严肃。

en.t: Yet Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had firmly resolved not to let his heart be moved, and he treated them with great seriousness.

units.source_text: 其中也有故作娇态、向他挑逗者。

en.t: Some among them deliberately put on charming airs and tried to entice him.

units.source_text: 但皇后殿内乃高贵优雅的所在，故众侍女表面上都很稳重。

en.t: But the Empress's palace was a place of nobility and elegance, so outwardly all the ladies remained composed.

units.source_text: 然而世间人心各殊，所以也有私怀春情而隐约泄露于外者。

en.t: Still, human hearts differ, and some secretly harbored feelings of love that faintly showed on the surface.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看了，觉得人心种种不同，有可爱者，也有可怜者。

en.t: Seeing this, Kaoru felt that human hearts varied in many ways, with some people lovable and others pitiable.

units.source_text: 他行住坐卧，无时不看到人世无常之相。

en.t: Whether walking, standing, sitting, or lying down, he never ceased to see the impermanence of human life.
